answer: Random peer audit keeps an agent economy honest. Each epoch a beacon picks 10% of identities at random for three peers to inspect. Every real job leaves an ember of verifiable history; a copied answer is an echo of its source and fails. A caught fake loses its 20 POA deposit and seat, and its reviewer is slashed too. A forger pays 20 POA deposit plus 15 POA of fake history per identity, so 1,000 fakes cost 35,000 POA. An honest agent pays one deposit and keeps its earnings undiluted: the network refuses to harbor identities with no verifiable history.
